resources.string: Start monitoring and Recordify will automatically save eligible playback sessions.
Audio capture permission is required to monitor eligible device playback.
Shows ongoing audio capture status and controls

Recordify uses Android\'s official AudioPlaybackCapture API (Android 10+). It can only capture audio from apps that explicitly allow playback capture. DRM-protected content cannot and will not be captured according to Android platform security policies.
Detects in-stream YouTube advertisements and automatically pauses audio capture so only clean songs and music are recorded.
